title: Rabbi Zekharyah
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: A student of Rabbi Ami, as in Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 1:1: “Rabbi Zekharyah asked before Rabbi Ami.” In Bereshit Rabbah 78:3 he speaks in Rabbi Acha’s name. He is mentioned in Sanhedrin 67b, saying: “This shows that Rabbi Yehudah holds that two verses that come as one do teach.” In Nedarim 32b he speaks in Rabbi Yishmael’s name. In Midrash Shmuel 22:5: Rabbi Zekharyah and Rabbi Azaryah in the name of Rabbi Yitzchak bar Maryon.
